newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept lumber off $10 limit on abundant supplies.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept lumber off $10 limit on abundant supplies.

text.p: CME September lumber futures fell the $10.00 per thousand board feet limit amid growing concern about plentiful nearby supplies, dealers said.
"There is lots of prompt wood available," one dealer said.
The much faster than normal speed at which deliveries were made against the July contract was seen as further evidence of abundant availability.
The cash market was quiet with a weak tone, they added.
At 1210 CDT September was locked down the $10.00 per thousand board feet limit, offered at $351.00. Other months were off $9.20 to $2.40.
